name: Murasaki Uina
source:
A resident of Uruoi-so. Lives in Room 6.

She works odd jobs. She’s always short on cash, so Shichirota often helps her out.

According to Shichirouta, “she smells really good.”

[from [url=https://winters.world.coocan.jp/newpage152.html]official site[/url]]
